summary: Frontend-only QA of the City Shops Opening-Hours + Stock/Discount enhancement (iteration 28). All 5 scenarios PASSED end-to-end with no console errors and no pageerrors. Shop browser correctly shows 4 Open pills + 1 Closed pill (Ironworks Hardware & Sports 08:00-18:00, current game time 18:38 → closed). Open shop (Kaeldor Fresh Foods) shows 'Open now' pill, per-item 'X in stock' badges, working 'Buy to Inventory' — Coffee stock 59→58 after buy, cash $199→$195 ($4 charge), and Coffee lands in Inventory. Closed shop shows red 'shop-closed-banner', 'Closed' pill, disabled 'Closed'-labelled buy buttons; click attempt is blocked (Playwright disabled-click timeout) and cash stays unchanged. Admin ▸ City Shops editor exposes shop-open-time / shop-close-time inputs and a Stock & Discounts table with cfg-cap-<id> / cfg-disc-<id> per item. Setting Coffee to cap=10, disc=25 and saving instantly propagates to the player Shop: sale-coffee shows −25%, base price $4 struck through, current price $3, stock capped at 10. Admin CRUD works: shop-new opens the editor, saving creates a new shop that appears in the admin list; shop-del-<generated-id> deletes it with a 'Deleted' toast. Coffee restored to cap=60 / disc=0, and the extra TEST shop deleted, leaving exactly the 5 seeded shops.
critical_code_review_comments: New-shop editor does NOT expose an editable shop-id input — id is auto-generated by the backend (verified in DOM: shop-del-7cc77a257a0543669d0fb6409a431dd5). This is fine functionally but if id conventions ever matter for import/export, consider allowing admin to specify a human-readable id.
admin-tab-city shops testid still contains a SPACE (carry-over from iteration 27). CSS selectors work but this remains fragile — recommend slugifying to admin-tab-city-shops.

Closed-shop banner copy is English and correct: 'This shop is closed right now. It opens 08:00–18:00. You can browse but can\'t buy until it reopens.' — however when a shop is closed for the day, the phrase 'It opens 08:00–18:00' technically describes the daily window rather than the next opening time. Minor UX nit — consider 'It opens daily 08:00–18:00'.
Cash update after buy is driven by act() re-fetching player state (as noted in iteration 27) — still works fine, no drift observed.
test_credentials: admin@kaeldor.com/admin123 and player@kaeldor.com/player123 (Neo) — both used, both worked.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 1 admin shop ('TEST QA Shop', auto-id 7cc77a257a0543669d0fb6409a431dd5, category pharmacy) — DELETED at end of test. Coffee capacity/discount was temporarily changed for the discount verification and RESET to cap=60 / disc=0 at end. Final shop count = 5 (seeded set intact).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. Shop testids used: store-<id>, store-status-<id> (list page); shop-open-status, shop-closed-banner, stock-<item_id>, buy-<item_id>, sale-<item_id> (detail page); admin: admin-tab-city shops (with SPACE), shop-edit-<id>, shop-del-<id>, shop-new, cityshop-editor, shop-open-time, shop-close-time, shop-items-config, cfg-cap-<item_id>, cfg-disc-<item_id>, shop-save. Ironworks is the standard 'closed' shop for QA — closes 18:00 game-time. Game clock ran ~18:38 → 18:41 during this session (Europe/Berlin sync).
rca of the issue: No bugs found — the enhancement works as specified across all 5 review scenarios.
